capabilities: Choose the folder each new attachment goes into from a token pattern
Rename attachments by a token pattern, with links following
Collect a note's existing attachments into the configured folder
Delete unused attachments after a confirmation
Keep attachments following their note on rename, move and delete
disambiguation: Not just a folder setting; it also renames, collects and deletes attachments and keeps them following their notes.
extras: Documentation is a demo vault shipped with each release and readable on GitHub; the plugin publishes an API for other plugin developers; git-based undo of bulk commands is desktop only and off by default; original-name sync storage uses a dedicated folder listed in Obsidian's Excluded files.
problem: Obsidian puts pasted images in one shared folder under generic timestamped names that say nothing about which note they belong to.
